name: navaja
description: MCP server for personal CENDOJ case-law research: advanced search over Spanish case law, full-text download with human-solved captchas, and batch management.

tools.name: buscar_sentencias
tools.description: Advanced search over CENDOJ case law with filters; no captcha required.

tools.name: listar_localizaciones
tools.description: List the site's own location vocabulary for use in search filters.

tools.name: ver_texto_completo
tools.description: Fetch the full text of a resolution with human-in-the-loop captcha solving.

tools.name: iniciar_descargas
tools.description: Start a non-blocking batch of full-text fetches.

tools.name: estado_descargas
tools.description: Poll lightweight metadata for a batch of downloads.

tools.name: recoger_descarga
tools.description: Collect the full payload for one finished batch job.

tools.name: cancelar_lote
tools.description: Cancel the queued jobs of a batch.

tools.name: estado_servidor
tools.description: Return runtime server configuration and the captcha form URL.
